newsitem.title: USA: Penn Traffic Q1 revenues $759 million.
newsitem.headline: Penn Traffic Q1 revenues $759 million.

text.p: Penn Traffic Co said on Tuesday that its first-quarter 1997 revenues were $759 million, down 8.3 percent from the same period last year.
Same-store sales for the period were down 8.1 percent.
The company said its "disappointing" sales reflect the continuation of a recent trend and the impact of newly implemented grocery merchandising programs.
Penn Traffic said it is taking steps to mitigate this impact.
The company said it will report full financial results for the quarter on June 2.
